name: R.I.P. - Roast in Peace
summary: Each episode simulates a funeral for one of the VIP guests, complete with a ceremonial setting and funereal atmosphere - but the tone is satirical and irreverent: The comedians compete to deliver the most "savage" roast.

name: Embers of the Night
summary: Gu Qingyu loses her family in a bombing. After face change, she seeks revenge on suspect Lin Jiming—then falls for him.

name: Love Legend
summary: Yun Shao, a young woman from a prominent clan, is brutally sacrificed by her own family to a blood jade ritual. After narrowly escaping death, she encounters Pei Zhao, a member of the Fengyi Guard, and the two become bound by fate through a mother-child Gu parasite. To seek justice for the tragic death of Yun Xiang and uncover the truth behind the strange disturbances at the blood jade mine, Yun Shao breaks through societal constraints to join the Fengyi Guard. As the investigation deepens, eerie blood rituals and dark royal secrets surface one after another. Court politics rage, and various factions scheme and clash. Yun Shao and Pei Zhao fight side by side against corruption and evil, holding fast to their principles amid crisis after crisis—searching for truth and a way forward within a maze of love, hate, and mystery.

name: Raiders of the Lost Pharaohs
summary: Tutankhamun, Ramses the Great, Cleopatra, Khufu…these legendary pharaohs built the wonders of Karnak, Luxor and the pyramids of Giza before their civilisation faded into obscurity. But in 1798, Napoleon Bonaparte's expedition to Egypt reopened the doors to a forgotten world and ignited a fascination with Ancient Egypt that continues to this day. Bold explorers, such as Jean-François Champollion and Giovanni Battista Belzoni, risked everything to unearth these wonders. Archaeology became a conquest, and Egypt's heritage was plundered by tomb raiders - until Auguste Mariette laid the foundations of modern Egyptology. This immersive series reveals the splendour of the pharaohs and the feats of the explorers.

name: UK Forensic Breakthroughs
summary: UK Forensic Breakthroughs analyses ten of the UK's toughest murder cases, where forensic science was crucial in bringing the killer to justice.

name: A Life of Bliss
summary: George Cole's first television series, continuing from his popular radio series, about a shy young bachelor.

name: Jones
summary: A powerful yet dysfunctional family gathers at a luxurious estate in Sintra to celebrate an engagement, but the festivities end in murder. Inspector Oliver Jones, who has the ability to communicate with the dead, teams up with Júlia, the sharp-witted and sarcastic victim, to uncover the killer. Amid family secrets, betrayals, and an agoraphobic English actress who dreams of becoming the next Sherlock Holmes, love and hatred intertwine, and every interaction reveals the complex bonds that hold this family together. Can the dead really help Jones solve the crime and uncover the culprit?

name: Shadows and Dust
summary: Gone but not forgotten. From the Peking Man to fugitive DB Cooper, from Columbus's sunken Santa Maria to Cambyses's vanished armies, history's missing pieces evade recapture. Ensnared in illicit dealings, cloaked in myth and rumour, hunted by the masses, phantom fragments inspire obsession and theories of sabotage, miscalculation, and worlds undone without warning. How did we allow these precious relics to slip from our grasp? And what, if anything, is left to be found? Investigators follow trails through the past, sifting through desert sands for ancient armour, combing coral reefs for traces of first contact and parsing FBI profiles for new suspects. Amid cloak and dagger rendezvous, forgotten testimonies, and new studies, are we on the verge of great rediscovery?

name: Η Κυρία Ντορεμί
summary: During the interwar period, a progressive, Paris-raised teacher returns to her roots in provincial Greece, where her modern views clash with a deeply conservative society, risking her career, her reputation, and her secret romance with a student.

name: NASCAR Americana
summary: A small, family-owned sport has turned into a one-of-a-kind phenomenon. Over 78 years of existence, NASCAR, a regional pastime, evolved into a popular national powerhouse by balancing its southern roots with a modern-day flair. In NASCAR Americana, the three-part docuseries explores the sport's rise by drawing on interviews and stories from stock-car racing's greats to examine how NASCAR has reflected and shaped the culture, identity, and character of a changing nation.

name: LEGO ONE PIECE
summary: A LEGO-animated retelling of ONE PIECE's early adventures, this two-part special follows Usopp as he recounts the Straw Hat Pirates' journey from the East Blue to the Grand Line for new crewmate Tony Tony Chopper. Packed with humor, action, and heart, the story reimagines iconic battles and friendships in a playful brick-built world.

name: Who The Hell Is Hamish?
summary: Who The Hell Is Hamish? is inspired by an industrious fraudster, and the group of victims who eventually decided they had had enough of him. The charming and cultured Hamish sets his sights on Bec, a recently divorced single mother with three sons and access to a significant family trust. When Bec notices gaps in his story and some odd behaviour, what starts as private unease widens into something far larger: a pattern of deception spanning continents and suspected of leaving more than $70 million in its wake.

name: Miracles of the ER
summary: At Yang-Da University Hospital, Associate Director of Emergency Medicine Chou Cheng-chun makes a bold decision to accept Lin Geng-ming, an average-performing medical school graduate. Lin joins the emergency department as a resident alongside elite peers, Tang Hsi and Chiang Tung-yen, working shoulder to shoulder to save lives. Together with senior attending physician He Yu-hua, the ER team faces relentless medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and internal power struggles within the hospital. Miracles of the ER delves into the complex dynamics between doctors and patients, patients and their families, revealing both the tension and the deep compassion that bind them all together.

name: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
summary: A new group of dynamic young mothers in Orange County collide in a community where beliefs are not just their religion; they are their identity. While some defend their way of life, fighting against modernity, others embrace change, becoming a platform to disrupt the status quo. Scandals and secrets will be revealed, facades will crumble, and families and friendships will change forever on both sides of the battlefield as this group of strong, game-changing influencers comes together to build their answer to #MomTok.

name: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
summary: In this bold reimagining of one of history's most controversial social experiments, thirty willing participants enter a real prison and are randomly assigned as guards or prisoners. Thrust into a system of power, hierarchy, and control, they'll discover whether ordinary people inevitably conform to the roles they're given—or whether empathy, morality, and individuality can withstand the forces pushing them in the opposite direction. As the pressure builds and the balance of power begins to shift, the central question feels more urgent than ever: Does power corrupt?

name: Aileen Wuornos: Damsel of Death
summary: Aileen Wuornos: Damsel of Death re-examines the crimes and life of one of America's most notorious female killers, drawing on FBI case files and testimony from Brian Jarvis, the lead detective who investigated Wuornos and questioned her following her arrest. Beginning with the murder of Richard Mallory in Florida in November 1989, the documentary traces a series of killings that left seven men dead over the following 11 months. As bodies were discovered along Florida's highways, all shot multiple times, investigators began searching for the person responsible.

name: Convictions Gone Bad with Will Mellor
summary: Will Mellor fronts this gripping true crime series, delving into five of the most shocking miscarriages of justice in legal history. Will unpacks how the system got it so disastrously wrong and reveals the crucial new evidence that finally set the wrongfully convicted, free. We hear from the falsely accused in their own words, providing an insight into what it's like to be arrested, tried and convicted of the most horrendous of crimes; and the subsequent battle to clear their name.

name: Baddies Gone Wild: Cancun
summary: The ladies are back and going even wilder! This season, they're taking their energy straight to Cancun for nonstop turn-ups, unforgettable nights, and plenty of unexpected moments along the way. With no telling what can happen when the girls hit the streets, beaches, and nightlife of Mexico, Cancun is about to experience Baddies Gone Wild like never before.

name: Food Samouraï
summary: The six-episode show sees Mory, accompanied by pastry chef and friend Theó Segretin and guests such as Omar Sy, immerse himself in Japanese culture and gastronomy to unlock how to prepare the perfect bento. Alongside Lupin star Sy are other guests including multi-Michelin-starred chef Pierre Gagnaire, writer Chihiro Masui.

name: Lola ylösalaisin
summary: Set in a tight-knit coastal community, the story follows a group of teenage girls navigating a world shaped by strict social hierarchies and traditional power dynamics. In this town, wealth and influence are concentrated within a few dominant families, creating a rigid system of control and compliance that directly impacts the lives of the youth.

name: The UnBelievable: Encounters with Dan Aykroyd
summary: What happens when an ordinary day takes a truly extraordinary turn? The UnBelievable: Encounters with Dan Aykroyd dives into history's strangest brushes with the unexplained—from alleged alien abductions and cryptid sightings to haunted houses, ghostly visitors, and demonic possessions. Whether you call them impossible, paranormal, or just plain weird, these are the encounters that left witnesses rattled, investigators scratching their heads, and skeptics wondering if there might be more out there than we can explain.

name: Happy Jack
summary: Happy Jack centers on Jack, a bit of a lifelong ne'er-do-well. He's got two great daughters, although his Dad deserves more credit for how they turned out. Kate runs Jack's company and keeps him on the rails while Sam is a wild child who is more like her Dad. When Sam comes home to introduce everyone to her new boyfriend, Jack's shocked to learn Paul, a former investment banker turned van life guru, is the same age as he is. Shocked at first, Jack soon realizes he's got a choice to make. Will he keep looking out for number one, or embrace this last chance to be a real part of his daughters' lives?

name: The Howard Stern Show
summary: Legendary innovator, broadcaster, and "King of All Media" Howard Stern brings his signature, long-running SiriusXM show to HBO Max.

name: La Señora
summary: La Señora is a fictionalized series that follows Catalina Rojas, a haughty, upper-middle-class woman who becomes the prime suspect in the attempted murder of several members of her own family, and the investigator on the case looking for justice.

name: Stacks of Cash
summary: Stacks of Cash is an edge-of-your-seat game show hosted by Emmy Award-nominated actor Mike O'Malley, where six contestants face off in a quiz-driven battle with towering stakes. Players answer questions to earn uniquely shaped blocks, then stack their way toward a gold line. One wrong move can send everything crashing down.

name: Cow Squad
summary: Animated series based on Chick-fil-A's new mascots, Sarge, Daisy and Carrots.

name: Bob's Game Night - Blood on the Clocktower
summary: Bob the Drag Queen hosts a deadly social deduction game in Ravenswood Bluff, where players must battle to expose evil secrets and shocking betrayal.

name: Deadly Destinations
summary: Deadly Destinations chronicles the stories of unsuspecting travelers whose lives are tragically cut short, and gradually reveals how their final stop holds critical clues needed to catch their killer.

name: Zarah: Wilde Jahre
summary: A lesbian journalist fights the patriarchy in 1970s Hamburg.

name: 24 Hour Millionaire
summary: 24 Hour Millionaire is an epic series that assembles the most skilled game players and puts them to the ultimate test: 24 nonstop hours of social strategy and physical competitions where one player is guaranteed to walk away with a $1 million prize.

name: Stacks of Cash
summary:
Duplicate of https://www.tvmaze.com/shows/94780/stacks-of-cash

On Stacks of Cash six contestants face off in a quiz-driven battle with towering stakes. Players answer questions to earn uniquely shaped blocks, then stack their way toward a gold line. One wrong move can send everything crashing down.

name: Made in the USA
summary: Made in the U.S.A. will track contestants' challenges to produce their ideas into full-scale products. One contestant will be eliminated each week; the last remaining inventor gets a contract with HSN.

name: Pop Pap Polters
summary: The remote control seems to have moved, and snacks have mysteriously disappeared? It might actually be the work of a mischievous ghost... This is a slightly whimsical and amusing story about three little ghost brothers, Pop, Pup, and Porta, who live inside the walls of a certain house.

name: The Sound of Sugar Cubes
summary: An orphan, Han Yul didn't have much in life but a dream to become a singer. That is, till he saw his best friend mercilessly murdered by someone he looked up to. Harold. Popular. Perfect. Psychopath. And rich enough to cover his tracks. On the run, Han Yul quits high school, changing his name with every new job he scrambles together. When a famous singer hears his voice and offers a chance at revenge, one question remains: can he sing?

name: His Wild Rose Strikes Again
summary:
On the day she is abandoned, Lu Chayao sets fire to her grandmother's courtyard. Amid the flames, she encounters the bloodied heir Lu Shiye. He takes her home, plotting to use this troubled beauty to overturn the situation between their two families. Yet, the more defiant she gets, the more he falls for her. From then on, the cunning and calculating Shiye lays the traps, while the shrewd and eccentric Chayao sets them in motion—teaming up to crush their enemies and save each other. 

This drama is adapted from the Fanqie Novel "Young Master, the Down-and-Out Girl You Brought Home Has Lost It Again" by author Miao Zong Shui Bu Xing.

name: My National Husband
summary: Qiao An Hao and Lu Jin Nian enter a fake marriage because of Xu Jia Mu's car accident, concealing their true feelings. Later, they join the same film crew and experience misunderstandings, mutual protection, and revelations about the past

name: Zmora
summary: A disgraced journalist returns to her hometown and sets out to investigate the unsolved disappearance of a childhood friend.

name: Political Lupin
summary: Set in the fictional country of Nipponia, the protagonist of this story is Kisaragi Yayoi, who sets her sights on "political money," whose use is often unclear. While outsmarting an elite politician who manages the ruling party's finances, she brilliantly seizes all of this shady political money.

name: LOST10
summary: The story is set in Hokkaido. Triggered by the Shikabadake Incident, a mountain accident that occurs during a guided climbing tour, this human suspense drama unfolds as the motives, senses of justice, evil, and complex emotions of the various people involved intertwine.

name: Pitch Invasion: How the USA Changed Soccer
summary: Star-spangled soccer, from Best to Beckham. How the USA gave a declining, hooligan-ridden sport a family friendly makeover. It didn't just grow the game, it changed it forever.

name: A Cloud Loves Me
summary: The story begins on Gu Yueji's 27th birthday, which turns into a disaster when her first love betrays her, dumps her, and leaves her burdened with debt. Right at her lowest point, a birthday cake deliveryman named Ren Jiangye arrives. Desperate for a fresh start, Yueji enters into a living arrangement and contract with him.

name: Thornbird
summary: Ten years after her father—the infamous serial killer Gabriel Thorn—was caught, 17-year-old Ryan Shipley is back in her childhood hometown of Starling, Tennessee, trying to lay low. No one can know who she really is. No one can know the truth about her past. All Ryan wants is a chance to live as a normal teenager, maybe even fall in love.

name: Pablo & Luisão
summary: The adventures of Pablo and Luisão. The production will bring to the small screen the hilarious stories of the artist's father and his best friend in a frustrated attempt to open their own businesses, the love-hate relationship between the two with their family and the holes they got into.

name: Alemão: Os Dois Lados do Complexo
summary: 2010: Just as the Brazilian government launch a military-assisted siege on one of Rio de Janeiro's most notorious and criminally-controlled favelas, the identities of four undercover policemen operating in the slum are accidentally leaked. As violence mounts, the favela's ruthless boss, orders his men to hunt them down.

name: Meu nome é Preta
summary: An intimate portrait of Preta's life, told through the artist's own perspective and exclusive archival material. The series explores the many sides of her personality, career, and experiences that shaped her remarkable journey.

name: Εκμέκ Παγωτό
summary: After many years of living in Africa, a family returns to Greece and tries to make a fresh start and stand on their own feet again. The grandmother prepares the evening meal, and her cooking becomes the reason for the whole family to gather. During the appetizer, all the issues troubling them come to the surface. In the first course, secrets are revealed and unbelievable stories unfold. But when the dessert arrives - ekmek ice cream - nothing seems quite so serious anymore.

name: Ο Επισκέπτης της Ομίχλης
summary: A professor of the high school in Ioannina, who many years ago had been forced to flee to Germany because he was unfairly accused of killing a student, returns after many years, determined to restore his name and discover the real culprit. In his homeland everyone is confronted with suspicion, and his presence is of crucial importance to the small society where he lives. But as his research progresses, he discovers that there are many more hidden secrets.

name: Big Money in the Morning
summary: A fast-paced, comprehensive look at the major issues driving the market, designed to help viewers navigate the complex financial forces shaping their future before the trading day begins.

name: Wo Jia Ge Bi Pan Si Dong
Tarcísio & Glória
summary: An opportunistic, corrupt businessman takes in a hyper-logical alien scientist studying human biology, creating chaos as she attempts to comprehend human ethics, culture, and romance through his shady world.

name: Nicolle Wallace Presents: 92NY on MS NOW
summary: MS NOW is launching a collaboration with The 92nd Street Y, New York to bring the cultural and community center's signature conversations to the network's weekend lineup in a new monthly series, Nicolle Wallace Presents: 92NY on MS NOW.

nextepisode.name: Nicolle Wallace & Former Trump Official Anthony Scaramucci

name: Caçador de Marajás
summary: A charismatic politician launches his career by portraying himself as a crusading reformer determined to tear down high-earning, corrupt state officials. However, his rise to the nation's highest office quickly unravels as severe economic collapse, rampant inflation, and personal financial scandals trigger his dramatic political downfall.

name: Herança em Jogo
summary: Thirteen strangers compete for a fortune left behind by the Deceased. To win the money, they work together on missions guided by the Executor. At the end of each mission, only one person receives the sum and decides whether or not to share it with the others.

name: Fast & Furious
summary: Fast & Furious is a live-action television series based on the hit movie franchise.

name: Mayday
summary: When the alarm sounds and everyone else seeks shelter, they cast off. We get a unique, raw glimpse into life aboard the rescue vessels—filmed by the crew themselves. These boats operate along the entire Norwegian coast to save lives and protect property.

name: Sam and Colby
summary: Join Sam and Colby as they explore and document the creepiest haunted sites. Maintaining their infectious humor in even the darkest of situations, paranormal investigation has never been more fun.

previousepisode.name: Demonic Encounter in Serial Killer Asylum

name: The Man and the Challenge
summary: A scientist tests problems of human survival. Unusual semi-documentary series with the accent of space training.

name: Mei Ying Shen Bu Zhi Long Zhong Que
Hug Each Other at the End of the Fireworks
summary: Lin Ting has been abandoned by the Lin family for many years. In order to save her seriously ill mother, she agreed to her father's request and held a grand business marriage with the second young master of the Tan family. But who knew that on the wedding day, her fiancé suddenly met with an accident, and their marriage was forced to end before it even began. For the sake of her mother, desperate Lin Ting had to turn to Tan Zheng Yu, the eldest son of the Tan family, hoping to use him to get herself out of this dire life. But the entanglement between the two accidentally pulled out a secret love that lasted for ten years, and the grand lie that the second young master Tan had woven for her.

name: The Man Called X
summary: Adventures of Ken Thurston, US Intelligence Bureau Agent - Code Name "X".

name: Vicky e a Musa
summary: When Euterpe, the Greek goddess of music, unexpectedly arrives in a vibrant Brazilian neighborhood, she summons a grieving young teenager named Vicky, using the transformative power of art and music to heal her community.

name: Die Düsteren
summary: On a North Sea island, sinister doppelgängers threaten the inhabitants. As Soma tries to discover who she really is, her past becomes the key to the mystery.

name: KERORO☆
summary: The Hinata household is your typical, everyday Japanese household, it consists of: Aki, the mother who is a manga editor, Natsumi, the older sister that is perfect at school, but bossy at home, Fuyuki, the little brother that is in the occult club at school, and Sgt. Keroro, the frog-like alien that was sent here as part of an invasion force to take over Pokopen (Earth). As the Sgt.'s comrades appear, the only defense against the invasion of Earth are the Hinata household and other friends.

nextepisode.name: My Friend Is an Invader / Sergeant Keroro in a Windowless, Bathless Room With History

name: Rota 66: A Polícia que Mata
summary: While thoroughly investigating the murder of two young men from São Paulo, reporter Caco Barcellos uncovers a group of ROTA hitmen operating with the apparent approval of the military justice system.

name: Além da Ilha
summary: The series takes place in a luxury resort on a desert island that inaugurates in Brazil the coveted mystery tourism, already known and explored in other parts of the world.

name: Os Parças - A Série
summary: The Buddies are back and on a difficult mission: Toinho, Pilôra, and Romeu need to free Ray Van, who was mistakenly kidnapped by a dangerous gang.

name: Second Plate
summary:
Kang Yu Hyeon once dreamed of becoming a chef and entered culinary school with complete confidence in his abilities. However, after meeting his exceptionally talented junior, O Min Gyeom, he is forced to confront a level of skill he cannot surpass. Unable to come to terms with the gap between them, Yu Hyeon gives up on his dream and drops out of university. 

Years later, Yu Hyeon is living an ordinary life as a product developer at a food company. Just when he thinks the past is behind him, he reunites with Min Gyeom, who has become a renowned chef, when the two are assigned to collaborate on the development of a new product.

As old wounds resurface and lingering feelings refuse to fade, the reunion challenges both men to face the past they never truly left behind.

name: Hide & Seek
summary:
Freelance journalist Tsukura becomes caught up in a bombing and loses his beloved girlfriend, Sana. He is then branded by the state as the terrorist who masterminded the attack and becomes a wanted fugitive!

Tsukura flees to South Korea, where he spends his days in despair. Then, incredibly, he receives a phone call from Sana...!? Is Sana still alive? Or is she actually someone else?

As Tsukura flees from the authorities while pursuing the truth about his mysterious girlfriend, a desperate game of escape and pursuit unfolds. Every character has a hidden side, and after one betrayal after another, Tsukura eventually arrives at a shocking truth.

name: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story
summary:
The re-opening of a mysterious 1985 cold case murder in Louisiana unearths a haunting history of bloodshed and long-buried trauma.

What begins as an investigation into a 1985 murder turns into a haunting exploration of a community's dark history of violence and bloodshed. Set in the rural bayou outside New Orleans, Louisiana, a harsh landscape steeped in supernatural lore and traditions, the story starts with the disappearance of Dorothy Lou Thompson - the owner of a pet cemetery that had been built on land long rumored to be cursed. Dorothy's body eventually turns up wrapped in chains in the Mississippi River, raising questions about her past and the people around her. With no concrete evidence, the case goes cold until 2009 when Det. John Doran reopens the investigation, following up on old leads and digging into the case files. Unexpectedly, a witness comes forward with a terrifying tale of Dorothy's ghost which compels him to come forward with information. Three years later, a second witness claims to be haunted by the murdered woman seeking vengeance. The vexing accounts launch a police investigation into Dorothy's tragic past, revealing a trail of dead husbands, a domineering mother Grace, who founded the cemetery after outrunning her own criminal acts, and the long shadow of a community steeped in evil deeds that were buried but not forgotten.

With insight from Dorothy's neighbors, law enforcement, local journalists, and scholars, the series unearths a labyrinthine tale involving multiple dead bodies, disturbing family secrets, and centuries-old massacres exposing the deep-seated horror and guilt that still haunt the community.

name: Dekiai Kareshi no Tsukurikata: Se kara Honmei ni Naru Onna no Ko no Hanashi
summary: Sakura, heartbroken after a physical encounter with her senior coworker Keisuke turns into cold rejection, finds herself unable to let him go. In her despair, she meets Zakuchan, a blunt "fairy of love" disguised as a doll who harshly scolds her choices. Guided by Zakuchan's strict romance lessons, Sakura sets out to transform her unrequited crush into becoming Keisuke's true girlfriend.

name: Hadakanboutachi
summary:
Sabasaki Ryo is a shoemaker and salesperson who innocently approaches any woman who catches his interest. It makes no difference to him whether the woman has a boyfriend or a spouse, and although those around him deride him as a "player" and a "jerk," he does not care in the slightest.

While enjoying a convenient, "almost-lovers" relationship with Tsutsui Momo, a dentist ten years his senior, Sabasaki also takes an interest in Momo's best friend, Hotta Kyoko, a mother of three. Driven by his desires, he finds himself wavering back and forth between the two women.

name: Doubt: 15-nen Me no Fukushu
summary: Fifteen years after surviving the serial killer "Komori," clinical psychologist Ando Kaede uses her hyper-acute hearing alongside her detective brother to hunt down their family's murderer. When the long-dormant case suddenly resurfaces, the siblings are drawn into a web of secrets and lies in pursuit of the truth.

name: Mikon Sagi
summary: Sayaka and Shinji appear to be a deeply loving married couple whose main struggle is their inability to conceive despite fertility treatments. Unbeknownst to Sayaka, who remains desperate to have a child with him, her seemingly perfect and supportive husband is keeping a major secret: two other women are involved in his life.

name: The Martians and Us
summary: Series about the history of British science fiction.

previousepisode.name: The End of the World as We Know It

name: Deadly Tag
summary: Chase, be chased, and survive. A deadly game of tag begins.

name: Love on Hire
summary: "Hired to end a love, never to fall into one." Her job is to make someone fall out of love. But her heart chooses the one she was never meant to love.

name: The Blossoming of Zhang Mei Li
summary: Because of a misunderstanding, Zhang Meili is sent to a wrong school, the Huaxia Global Universal Extravagant High School. This wouldn't actually be a problem if the school wasn't known for housing stuck-up young men. Thus, she meets many beautiful "younglings" at her new school, though, they are all mean. For Zhang it is now: take a deep breath and get to it!

name: That Winter Solstice
summary: On the day of the winter solstice, Nan Zhaoning and Jing Shuo were married. However, on the very first day of their marriage, Jing Shuo revealed that he planned to undergo assisted suicide in a year due to his chronic pain and disability. If he was once her light, she would now have to become his light, breathing love and a will to live into him.

name: A visszavágó – Kapj el, ha tudsz!
summary: This pan-European reality chase show is based on the 'Catch Us If You Can' format and is a spin-off of the earlier series 'Most Wanted – A hajsza'. In this version, celebrity pairs are the ones pursuing Balázs and his team.

name: Just Eating a Meal Together
summary: Trapped in unfulfilling marriages, cooking instructor Taki and home-cooked meal lover Rei bond over shared dishes, struggling to control their deepening attraction within the strict boundary of only eating together.

name: Bennie
summary: Bennie, a headstrong boy with Down syndrome, turns 18. Now that he is finally an adult, he wants a real job, happiness in love, and to live on his own. Just like everyone else. His fight for independence turns his delightfully dysfunctional family completely upside down. With his disarming humor, Bennie fights against all prejudices and inspires his parents, sister, and brother to choose themselves and each other again, too.

name: Recipe of the Year
summary:
The ABC is bringing Australians together around the kitchen table with Recipe of the Year, a heart-warming cooking competition hosted by beloved cook Adam Liaw and acclaimed actor and food lover Pia Miranda.

Set on a picturesque country farm, the seven-part series sees home cooks compete for the ultimate title: Australia's Recipe of the Year. From family recipes shaped by culture and passed down through generations to ingeniously simple weeknight winners that will put a smile on everyone's face, Recipe of the Year celebrates the stories and flavours that make up Australia today.

At the heart of the competition is the Country Women's Association (CWA), bringing generations of cooking wisdom. The home cooks face the formidable CWA judges each week, tackling classic CWA recipes from scones to jam rolls in the hope of winning a coveted CWA ribbon.

name: The State of Man
summary: In the new three-part documentary series The State of Man, award-winning journalist Marc Fennell investigates the powerful online movement influencing how a generation of boys and young men see themselves and navigate the world.

name: Bureau Groningen
summary: Ewout Genemans spends six months shadowing police officers in Groningen. He joins six police pairs who are on standby day and night to intervene whenever necessary. Ewout empathizes with the officers in all kinds of intense situations and, in doing so, gets to know the person behind the uniform.

name: Only Fools and Horses: The Lost Archive
